The Mayas' Disappearance

1ros BGU | Week: May 25-29 | Useful English for historical theories.

Mystery + evidence + theory / Misterio + evidencia + teoría

Image Support / Apoyo visual

Listening Support / Apoyo auditivo

Teacher read-aloud script: Listen. The Maya built great cities with temples, roads, and markets. Some cities were later abandoned. A long drought might have damaged the crops. War could have made life dangerous. Families may have moved to other places. The Maya did not simply vanish. Their culture is still alive today. A good theory uses evidence and respect.

Adapted Reading / Lectura adaptada

Why Did Some Maya Cities Disappear?

The Maya built great cities with temples, roads, and markets. Today, some of these cities are quiet ruins. Many people ask one big question: Why did some Maya cities disappear? Archaeologists study evidence. In some places, there was less rain for many years. A long drought might have damaged the crops. Without enough food and water, families could have moved to other places. There may have been wars between cities, too. War could have made life dangerous. We do not know only one answer. The Maya civilization did not simply vanish. Many Maya people continued living in different areas, and their culture is still alive today. A good theory uses evidence and respect.

Vocabulary / Vocabulario

disappear desaparecer
Some cities seemed to disappear.
drought sequía
A drought might have damaged the crops.
crops cultivos
Crops need water.
evidence evidencia
A good theory uses evidence.
theory teoría
My theory is about drought.
ruins ruinas
The city is now ruins.

Theory Frames / Frases para teorías

must have = I am almost sure. / Estoy casi seguro.

might have = maybe. / Tal vez.

could have = possible. / Es posible.

Example: The drought might have damaged the crops.

Notebook Evidence / Evidencia en cuaderno

In your notebook / En tu cuaderno:

  1. Write 3 words from the video or reading.
  2. Write 1 possible cause: drought / war / disease / migration / other.
  3. Write 1 theory sentence with must have, might have, or could have.
  4. Write 1 question for class in Spanish or English.

Pair Preparation / Preparación en pareja

Prepare one line for class:

My theory is: The Mayas might have __________ because __________.
